commands.path: create collection apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create collection reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coassemble create collection apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new collection of courses; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: delete client apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete client reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coassemble delete client apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: irreversibly removes a client (multi-tenant sub-account) and its documented on-delete effects on associated users; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: delete collection apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete collection reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coassemble delete collection apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: soft-deletes a collection (recoverable via restore_collection); approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: delete course apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete course reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coassemble delete course apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: soft-deletes a course (recoverable via restore_course within Coassemble's retention window); approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: delete tracking apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete tracking reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coassemble delete tracking apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently erases one learner's tracking/progress record for a course; irreversible, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: delete translation apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete translation reverse-ETL action
